Human Resources

People, policies & employee experience

Responsible for job postings, candidate sourcing and screening, interview coordination, and new employee onboarding at AEC.
Labor contracts, employee files, staffing records, personnel changes and documentation controls; created AEC's employee-record management procedure.
Fully responsible for employee timekeeping, payroll processing and insurance administration, including attendance reconciliation, payroll calculation and verification, social insurance procedures, employee health insurance and related records.
Internal regulations, leave and recruitment procedures, employee records, and the administration of labor-related requirements.
Annual employee health checks, vaccination coordination and planning of internal events. Negotiated lower health check-up costs while maintaining an equivalent package.

Business Operations

Processes, resources & business continuity

Supported CEO-led lease negotiations and cost control, contributing to an 8% rent reduction in 2025 and a reduction of up to 15% for six months in 2026; worked with landlords and internal stakeholders.
Needs assessment, supplier search, quotation comparison, price negotiation, purchase approval, delivery acceptance, payment records and supplier follow-up.
Directly handled changes to clinic operating-license information and medical staff registration; coordinated advertising permits, interpreter registration and inspections with relevant parties and health authorities.
Built one new employee-record management process and improved five existing areas: internal labor rules, leave management, payment, procurement and recruitment procedures.
End-to-end planning of 2025 AEC team-building and gala events; handled COVID-era three-on-site workforce coordination at WinMart Hung Gia.
